title: Two-Point Line
summary: Distance, slope, and y-intercept from two points. 49 bytes.

body.text: Enter A,B = (x1,y1) and X,Y = (x2,y2). Pauses: distance, slope m, intercept c so the line is y = mx + c. After the run RCL D, RCL M, RCL C keep those three numbers.

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: 49 bytes of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in COMP. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).
Question: Use this program to solve the case: A(3, −2), B(4, 1).
Question: Use this program to solve the case: Horizontal line (1, 5) and (4, 5).
Question: Use this program to solve the case: Vertical line (2, 1) and (2, 4).
Given: Δx = 0 so slope is undefined.

items: Distance 3, then Math ERROR on Y÷X. The line is x = 2; this program cannot print a y = mx + c form

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: Last assignment uses original B (y1) and A (x1); X and Y have already become Δx and Δy. For a perpendicular bisector, slope is −1/M and the line passes through the midpoint.
